newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ramos warns bankers on lending money to politicians.
newsitem.headline: Ramos warns bankers on lending money to politicians.

text.p: Philippine president Fidel Ramos has warned bankers against the increasing loan applications of politicians starting this year as most of which would be used just for political campaigns.

Ramos advised bank presidents whom he met in a closed-door meeting recently to scrutinise all loan applications especially made by incumbent local officials, the presidential palace said in a statement released on Saturday.
A simultaneous presidential and local election is slated in May next year, but jockeying for positions and political campaigns have started nearly a year and a half in advance.
"As the political season heats up, some of them will resort to various ploys just to ensure that they get reelected," Ramos told the bankers.

Ramos said many officials would apply for loans supposedly to finance infrastructure projects in their districts, but he pointed out most local government projects are already funded either by the national government or through the local development fund.
The ruse was discovered before the 1995 local elections when the formerly state-controlled Philippine National Bank received a lot of loan applications by local officials.
